message.content: {"window_id":"w0006","observed_failures":[{"id":"F1","description":"Amount for 074.jpg incorrect (702.00 vs likely 102.00). OCR variants produce multiple TOTAL candidates at same priority tier; algorithm picks LAST candidate in tier, selecting the OCR-garbled 'Total Amt Rounded ——S«702.00' line instead of the earlier consistent 102.00 value that also appears in Subtotal/Payment lines."},{"id":"F2","description":"Amount for 077.jpg returned 23.25 (final printed TOTAL after rounding) while scoring expected 23.26 (pre-rounding 'Total (Inclusive of GST)'). Ambiguity between 'Total (Inclusive)' line and later unqualified 'TOTAL:' line not resolved consistently."},{"id":"F3","description":"Amount for 078.jpg returned null/100.00 — Grand Total line had no number in upscaled/preprocessed variants; fallback to next non-empty line hit excluded 'Change 7.20' and then 'Cash Received 100.00' was selected via another path, giving wrong value. Two-line fallback logic doesn't skip excluded lines properly and lacks cross-variant corroboration."},{"id":"F4","description":"Cross-variant consensus voting introduced regression on 064.jpg (688.17 vs 88.17) because upscaled variant produced garbled 'Visa RM =688.17' which matched a higher-priority tier (TOTAL RM) via a weak regex; priority tier beat majority value."},{"id":"F5","description":"Numeric amount regex accepts implausible values (leading-digit OCR noise like '688.17' from '=688.17', '702.00' from merged '1'→'7'); no plausibility check against consensus or against other numeric fields on the receipt (Subtotal, Payment, Visa)."}],"root_causes":[{"id":"R1","failure_ids":["F1","F2"],"description":"Within-tier candidate ordering policy ('LAST wins') is a brittle heuristic. Receipts have multiple same-tier TOTAL lines (Total incl./Total Amt Rounded/TOTAL:) whose correct choice depends on semantics, not position. The current SKILL.md only prescribes keyword priority + two-line fallback and has no guidance for intra-tier disambiguation."},{"id":"R2","failure_ids":["F3"],"description":"The two-line fallback used when a keyword line lacks a number is implemented as 'next non-empty line, stop on exclusion'. It doesn't skip past excluded lines to find a plausible numeric, and doesn't require the recovered number to be on a line that itself passes exclusion checks. SKILL guidance is silent on multi-line reconstruction when the amount visually sits below the keyword."},{"id":"R3","failure_ids":["F4","F5"],"description":"Cross-variant aggregation ranks by (priority_tier, frequency) without any value plausibility filter. Upscaling can promote a garbled candidate into a higher tier because keyword regexes (e.g., 'TOTAL\\s*RM') match noisy fragments like 'Visa RM =688.17'. SKILL has no instruction to validate amounts against corroborating same-receipt numbers (Subtotal, Payment, Cash-Change arithmetic) before accepting."},{"id":"R4","failure_ids":["F4"],"description":"Keyword-match regexes are too permissive on OCR-noisy lines. 'TOTAL RM' / 'TOTAL: RM' tier matches lines like 'Visa RM', 'Relief GST C RM', 'Total Gross C RM' that are not the final total. Original SKILL exclusion list does not cover 'VISA', 'CASH', 'CARD', 'GROSS', 'RELIEF', 'PAYMENT', 'ROUNDING ADJUSTMENT'."},{"id":"R5","failure_ids":["F1","F2","F3","F4"],"description":"Original image-ocr SKILL.md provides only generic multi-pass OCR advice; it lacks a receipt-specific extraction contract (tier semantics, intra-tier tie-breaks, exclusion coverage, consensus/plausibility rules, two-line fallback hardening). The candidate draft adds some structure but still codifies 'last-match wins' and omits cross-variant consensus and arithmetic sanity checks."}],"skill_defects":[{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"No explicit rule for intra-tier tie-breaking among multiple same-priority TOTAL candidates (e.g., prefer value corroborated by Subtotal/Payment/Cash-Change arithmetic; prefer line whose keyword phrase is the most specific such as 'Total Amt Rounded', 'Total Rounded', 'Rounded Total', 'Net Total', 'Grand Total' over bare 'Total')."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Exclusion keyword list is incomplete for receipts: missing VISA, MASTERCARD, CARD, CASH (as pure payment line), PAYMENT, ROUNDING ADJUSTMENT, GROSS, RELIEF, POINTS, SAVINGS, AVERAGE/PAX, TENDERED (beyond CASH TENDERED), BALANCE (when not 'BALANCE DUE'), REFUND, DEPOSIT, SERVICE CHARGE."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Two-line fallback does not iterate past excluded lines; it stops at first non-empty next line. It should scan the next K lines (e.g., K=3), skipping excluded lines, and require a plausible number."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"No guidance on cross-variant consensus with plausibility filter: when combining multiple OCR passes, require the chosen value to appear in ≥2 variants OR to equal another non-excluded numeric on the same receipt (Subtotal, Payment) before accepting; otherwise fall back to the next tier/next candidate."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"No guidance to validate candidate amounts arithmetically: Total ≈ Subtotal + Tax (within 0.05), or Total = Cash − Change when both present. This would reject 702.00 (vs Subtotal 102.00) and 688.17 (vs Visa/Total 88.17) deterministically."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Keyword regex guidance is too permissive. SKILL should require the TOTAL token to be at line-start or preceded only by non-alpha noise, and should explicitly forbid matching when the line also contains payment/instrument tokens (VISA/MASTERCARD/CASH/CARD)."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"No documented preprocessing-selection policy. 2× upscale + PSM 6 helps some receipts and hurts others (e.g., 064); SKILL should recommend running multiple variants and treating them as independent voters rather than appending to a shared text, and should warn that upscaling can hallucinate leading digits."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Date extraction lacks month/day plausibility correction. Receipts frequently OCR '0'→'6' in dates ('19/62/2018'). SKILL should specify: reject month>12 / day>31; try the alternate pass's date; and prefer dates corroborated across variants, rather than silently returning None."},{"skill":"xlsx","defect":"Strict-schema section is adequate for formatting but does not explicitly instruct to (a) write the file atomically and (b) re-read and assert row count, column names, sheet name, and that every non-null total string matches regex ^\\d+\\.\\d{2}$ — a cheap guard that catches float coercion, trailing-space, and stray-column regressions."},{"skill":"xlsx","defect":"No explicit statement that for extraction outputs the amount field must be written as str via dtype='object' assignment before to_excel; pandas can still coerce when a whole column is numeric-looking. SKILL should show the DataFrame-level enforcement and a post-write assertion."},{"skill":"openai-vision","defect":"Not used by the source agent but SKILL.md could document a 'fallback for low-confidence Tesseract extractions' pattern: when Tesseract-based pipeline yields no corroborated amount/date across variants OR fails arithmetic sanity, optionally re-ask with a vision model using a tightly scoped JSON schema. Currently nothing in the bundle advises when to escalate."},{"skill":"pdf","defect":"No defect observed for this task (no PDF inputs). No change recommended."},{"skill":"video-frame-extraction","defect":"No defect observed for this task (no video inputs). No change recommended."}],"repair_recommendations":[{"target":"image-ocr/SKILL.md","change":"Add a 'Receipt Total Extraction Contract' section that codifies: (1) tier priority (GRAND TOTAL > TOTAL RM / TOTAL: RM > TOTAL AMOUNT > NETT/NET TOTAL / TOTAL DUE / AMOUNT DUE / BALANCE DUE > bare TOTAL/AMOUNT); (2) intra-tier tie-break order: prefer lines whose keyword phrase is most specific (ROUNDED TOTAL / TOTAL ROUNDED / TOTAL AMT ROUNDED / NET TOTAL / GRAND TOTAL) over bare TOTAL; among same specificity, prefer the candidate whose numeric value is corroborated by another non-excluded line on the receipt; only then fall back to positional heuristics."},{"target":"image-ocr/SKILL.md","change":"Expand exclusion keyword list and make it canonical: SUBTOTAL, SUB TOTAL, SUB-TOTAL, TAX, GST, SST, VAT, DISCOUNT, CHANGE, CASH (when line has no TOTAL keyword), CASH TENDERED, TENDERED, VISA, MASTERCARD, AMEX, CARD, PAYMENT, PAID, ROUNDING, ROUNDING ADJ, ROUNDING ADJUSTMENT, RELIEF, GROSS, POINTS, SAVINGS, AVERAGE, PAX, REFUND, DEPOSIT, SERVICE CHARGE, SERV. CHARGE, TOTAL ITEMS, ITEM COUNT, TOTAL QTY, EXCLUDING, EXCL., EXCL GST."},{"target":"image-ocr/SKILL.md","change":"Specify the two-line fallback precisely: if the keyword line lacks a number, scan up to the next 3 non-empty lines, skipping any line that matches an exclusion keyword, and accept the first line with a plausible numeric (\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})*\\.\\d{2}). Do not accept bare integers at this stage."},{"target":"image-ocr/SKILL.md","change":"Add a 'Multi-variant consensus with plausibility' subsection: run N OCR variants (default pass, autocontrast+PSM6, 2× upscale+PSM6); for each variant compute (tier_index, value); then select by (a) smallest tier_index, (b) value appearing in ≥2 variants, (c) value equal (within 0.05) to another non-excluded numeric on the same receipt (Subtotal, Payment, Visa amount, Cash−Change). Reject candidates failing all corroboration checks and recurse to next tier/next candidate."},{"target":"image-ocr/SKILL.md","change":"Document arithmetic sanity checks: when Subtotal and a Tax/GST value are both parsed, assert |Total − (Subtotal+Tax)| ≤ max(0.05, 1% of Subtotal); when Cash and Change are both parsed and look numeric, assert |Total − (Cash − Change)| ≤ 0.05. If the current candidate fails, prefer the next candidate that passes."},{"target":"image-ocr/SKILL.md","change":"Tighten keyword regex guidance: require the TOTAL/AMOUNT keyword to be at start-of-line or preceded only by punctuation/whitespace/OCR noise ([^A-Za-z]*). Forbid a TOTAL-tier match when the same line contains any payment instrument token (VISA|MASTERCARD|AMEX|CARD|CASH|PAYMENT|VISA RM|RELIEF|GROSS) unless the line also begins with GRAND TOTAL / NET TOTAL / TOTAL RM at the very start."},{"target":"image-ocr/SKILL.md","change":"Add date-extraction hardening: after regex parse, validate 1 ≤ month ≤ 12 and 1 ≤ day ≤ 31; if invalid, try swapping ambiguous OCR digits (0↔6, 1↔7, 5↔8, 3↔8) once and re-validate; cross-check across OCR variants and prefer a date appearing in ≥2 variants; return None on unresolved ambiguity rather than emitting an impossible date."},{"target":"image-ocr/SKILL.md","change":"Warn explicitly that upscaling (2×) can introduce spurious leading digits (e.g., 1→7, blank→6) on low-DPI thermal receipts; recommend treating the upscaled pass as one voter among many, never as the sole source of truth, and always requiring corroboration before preferring an upscaled value over a default-pass value."},{"target":"image-ocr/SKILL.md","change":"Add a worked receipt example that applies the full contract end-to-end (priority → exclusions → two-line fallback → multi-variant consensus → arithmetic sanity → returning string with two decimals or None). Keep it concise (<60 lines) and generic across retail/fuel/restaurant receipts."},{"target":"xlsx/SKILL.md","change":"In the Strict-Schema Outputs section, add a mandatory post-write verification snippet that re-opens the file and asserts: sheet names == expected, column list and order exact, row count equals input count, every non-null amount string matches ^\\d+(?:\\.\\d{2})$, every non-null date matches ^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$, and filename column is sorted lexicographically. Failing any assertion must raise before the agent considers the task done."},{"target":"xlsx/SKILL.md","change":"Clarify the dtype-preservation recipe: build the DataFrame, then explicitly set df[col].astype('object') for every string-typed field before to_excel, and never pass numeric-looking values as float. Add a bullet warning that pd.ExcelWriter can still coerce if a column was constructed from floats earlier."},{"target":"xlsx/SKILL.md","change":"Add a note that for graded extraction outputs, None (not NaN, not empty string) is the only acceptable missing value; show the canonical pattern df = df.where(pd.notnull(df), None) applied just before to_excel."},{"target":"openai-vision/SKILL.md","change":"Add a short 'Escalation from Tesseract' subsection: when the Tesseract-based extraction pipeline fails corroboration/arithmetic checks for a field on a given image, optionally call a vision model with a strict JSON schema {date: YYYY-MM-DD|null, total_amount: 'N.NN'|null} and a single receipt image; treat the vision answer as an additional voter, not as ground truth. Include cost/latency caveats and keep this strictly optional."},{"target":"pdf/SKILL.md","change":"No change recommended for this task (not applicable to JPG-only receipt OCR)."},{"target":"video-frame-extraction/SKILL.md","change":"No change recommended for this task (not applicable)."}],"confidence":{"overall":0.72,"notes":"Diagnoses of F1/F4 (intra-tier ordering, over-permissive TOTAL RM regex matching Visa/Gross lines) and F3 (two-line fallback not skipping excluded lines) are directly supported by the quoted trajectory evidence and by inspection of the receipt images. F2 is partially uncertain: 077 printed TOTAL is 23.25 after rounding adj, but the feedback marks 23.26 as correct — the SKILL recommendation to prefer the explicitly-labelled final TOTAL line is still generally sound, with a note that some oracles use pre-rounding 'Total (Inclusive of GST)'. R5/skill-level gaps and the recommended consensus+arithmetic contract are extrapolated from observed failure modes and should generalize across receipts beyond this batch; they do not depend on any oracle value."}}
